News.SubTitle: Initial Release!
News.Title: <#a1e3fe>M</color><#fffca1>i</color><#7975ff>r</color><#5049fe>a</color> <#a1e3fe>O</color><#ffea9f>v</color><#8d89ff>e</color><#665eff>r</color><#5049fe>l</color><#a1e3fe>o</color><#7975ff>a</color><#665eff>d</color><#5049fe>e</color><#3b34db>d</color> 1.0.0 Release!
Text: <#a1e3fe>M<#fffca1>i<#7975ff>r<#5049fe>a <#a1e3fe>O<#ffea9f>v<#8d89ff>e<#665eff>r<#5049fe>l<#a1e3fe>o<#7975ff>a<#665eff>d<#5049fe>e<#3b34db>d, as you probably already know, is a mod created by the <#FF0000>Sabotaged AU Modding team, in an attempt to expand TOU Mira to the extreme, adding tens of roles and modifiers.
While the mod currently doesn't have as many roles as we want, last we counted there were over 59 roles/modifiers we wanted to add!

We reccomend using this mod with other extension mods, such as <link=https://github.com/rewalo/TownOfUsMiraRolesExtension>Roles Extension Mod</link>, <link=https://github.com/DivaniNL/TownOfUsMiraDivaniModsAddOn>Divani Mods</link>, or a proximity chat mod like <link=https://github.com/artriy/Perfect-Comms>PerfectComms</link>!

If you want to know what roles do what, what options do what, and ANYTHING else about MiraOverloaded, look at the <link=https://github.com/SabotagedAU/MiraOverloaded/wiki>Wiki</link> and join our <link=https://discord.gg/JpXFCZQWnc>Discord</link>!
